# UnlockMouse

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
UnlockMouse:Void
```

## Description

Lets the pointer leave the window again after [LockMouse](LockMouse). It does nothing if the mouse is not locked.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
